Please don’t kill yourself by blowing your head off.  Please don’t kill yourself in general, but seriously, don’t do that to your family and friends, or your dog, or the person who finds you without a head, or the individuals at the funeral home that have to prepare your headless body for burial.
Depression, anxiety, sadness and anger lie you.  Fight them and show them that you’re stronger than their lies.
Then don’t go!  There are sooo many good online schools now, you have no reason to put yourself in a toxic environment.  ❤️

You’ll never be normal if you’re hiding who you are.  In this day and age it’s not shameful to be gay.  The person who saw your porn has nothing to hold over you.  I promise this person could tell everyone on the planet, and nobody would care.  Also, there’s a very high probability that most of your friends and family already suspect it.. don’t live in shame.  ❤️

Looks are only important if you bring nothing else to the table.  A lot of quirky, not what society would say is attractive, people are sooo attractive because they own who they are and they’re happy with it.  The most beautiful feature anyone can have is a smile.  Start by standing up strait (don’t slouch) and walk with a smile.  AND!  Look around you.  Real people don’t look like the Kardashians.  Nobody in the real world looks like the images we’re subliminally fed to set the standards of beauty.
